note: ReactVibe, a React/Tailwind section + component library. /docs/blocks/<kind>/<name> (17; e.g. /docs/blocks/cta/flux-cta = 'React CTA Section Component') and /docs/dashboard-ui/<kind>/<name> (15; e.g. /docs/dashboard-ui/chart/comparative-bar-chart) are one component doc page each with the element in its own <kind> segment, so <kind> must be a taxonomy element (cta, faq, footer, hero, navigation, pricing, testimonials, chart, list, table). Two kinds are not element slugs and get an explicit template instead: /docs/blocks/navigation/* (4 navbar pages — 'navigation' is not an alias of navbar, so the {element} template skips them; morph-nav and overlay-nav still take navbar from their name, morph-menu and overlay-menu stay untagged) and /docs/dashboard-ui/widget/* (1; insight-recommendation-card → card). /docs/components/<name> (11), /docs/motion/<name> (14), /docs/backgrounds/<name> (4) and /docs/text/<name> (1) are single component pages whose element comes from tagItem on the name. The <kind> index pages (/docs/blocks/cta, /docs/dashboard-ui/table … — site-wide nav, unusable as elements_from), /docs/dashboard-systems/* (7), /docs/templates/* (3) and /docs/dark-mode are listings/templates and do not match. 67 items, 41 with an element (61%).
